text:
Service is always delayed, twice in a row now 😑

- My today appointment was at 15:00, i was right on time. And they told me to go to the 3rd floor and wait for 30 mins. Then what was the appointment for?

- When i walked into the door and received their greetings, they asked me if i want a full receipt and i said ‘yes’. But then after i paid for the service, they were like ‘oh do you need a receipt?’ And spent another 15 mins to generate the receipt for me…

Saw there’s other similar complaints since 1-2 years ago, not sure whether such matters has really taken into the clinic’s account 🫤 So probably suggest you go find other place to avoid disappointment.
